headline: Marketing Operations | CRM & Data Workflows | Reporting Automation
headline_rationale: CareerSwift operations role focuses on organized data, CRM, workflows, reporting and coordination. Emphasize verified integrations, databases, recurring reporting and process standardization, differentiating from its performance marketing opening.
summary: Marketing operations practitioner combining systems integration, organized data and practical reporting. Installed Go High Level, connected it with ServiceTitan, Power BI and internal systems, and trained employees on its use. Built recurring reporting across more than ten channels with Python, SQL and Funnel.io, maintained marketing and financial databases, and standardized agency account processes. Cross-functional experience with marketing, sales, IT and operations supports reliable workflows, clearer campaign information and efficient execution.
factual_review: Read exact CareerSwift Marketing Operations Specialist posting. Master Any Hour CRM work and E009/E072/E081/E060/E066/E116 support all claims. HubSpot/Salesforce are supported tools; no Marketo/Mailchimp or specific unverified lifecycle automation results claimed. Distinct emphasis and summary from3004.
tools_rationale: Source-backed CRM, spreadsheets, reporting and automation tooling appropriate to marketing operations.
